page.overview:
Who is Bin?

Bin grew up in one of the outlying Fire Islands, and never really bought into the propaganda that was drilled into citizens day in and day out during the Hundred Year War. Most people assumed that Bin was dumb, but he was smart enough to realize that the Fire Nation nobility was running the longest con on earth, which was making people believe nobles were better than others.

When he was old enough, Bin started using his hulking appearance to intimidate rich people out of their money, and ended up making a living doing so long-term. His biggest stunt as of a few years after the war was helping the pirate Captain Mosi of the Dancing Nobleman Fleet steal a broken down airship from a Fire Nation junkyard.

After the war, Bin began to wonder if there was more to life than just a good laugh and a good con.

A joking individual, Bin was often assumed to be dumb as well as big and strong, but he had an eye for being able to scam rich nobles. He was also known for having a wild deameanor.
